name: Turning Point USA
summary: A conservative youth organization founded in 2012 by Charlie Kirk and Bill Montgomery, with campus chapters nationwide and affiliates including the campaign arm Turning Point Action. Its conferences, such as AmericaFest and the Student Action Summit, feature leading figures of the Trump movement. Kirk was assassinated at a campus event in Utah in September 2025, and his widow Erika Kirk became CEO.

connections.name: Charlie Kirk
connections.description: Co-founded it in 2012 and led it until he was assassinated at Utah Valley University in September 2025.

connections.name: Erika Kirk
connections.description: Charlie Kirk's widow; the board unanimously elected her CEO on September 18, 2025.

connections.name: Richard Uihlein
connections.description: Through the Ed Uihlein Family Foundation, which Richard Uihlein heads and mainly funds: $50,000 in 2014 and $250,000 in 2022 per its IRS filings; tallies of the total range from $275,000 to more than $2 million.

sources.title: Business-related organizations financially supported Charlie Kirk's Turning Point USA for years — Fox Business

connections.name: Ron DeSantis
connections.description: In October 2025 DeSantis announced a partnership to bring its Club America chapters to high schools across Florida.

connections.name: Donald Trump Jr.
connections.description: Kirk ran travel, media and errands for Trump Jr. during the 2016 campaign; Trump Jr. remains a regular speaker at its summits, including 2025.

connections.name: Nick Fuentes

connections.name: Nigel Farage
connections.description: Its British offshoot, Turning Point UK, was set up on his recommendation and approved by Kirk.
